description: New workspace crate: Rust-first port of LIGGGHTS granular DEM. Reference: LIGGGHTS-PUBLIC and LAMMPS GRANULAR. Owns DEM, contact mechanics, granular/particle heat transfer, pebble-bed and packed-bed physics; future CFD-DEM coupling to OUTRAM-FOAM (op-2kk). One of the three Phase-II architectural pillars kept separate: (1) thermophysical properties [tampines], (2) CFD/multiphase [outram-foam], (3) DEM/granular [this]. Roadmap Phases 1-5 are child beads. Workspace hard rules apply: enum dispatch (no Box/dyn), no lifetime params (Arc/index ids), Arc<RwLock> for shared state, non-GUI lib must compile/run on Android/Termux, GPLv3-compatible with upstream provenance headers on any ported file. Definition of done per physics bead: theory docs + verification tests + reference-benchmark comparison + unit-safe uom; humans own physics/V&V/judgement. Trademark-compliant name follows the outram-park-fork-<project> convention (cf. op-ahi). Source: Theodore Ong, 'OUTRAM PARK Phase II Architecture', 2026-07-23 (rough; CLAUDE.md takes precedence).

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: LICENSING RESOLVED (was mis-flagged): LIGGGHTS-PUBLIC source headers (src/lammps.h, src/lammps.cpp) declare 'GNU Public License, version 2 OR LATER', which IS GPL-3 compatible. Porting LIGGGHTS-PUBLIC source into this GPL-3.0-only crate is permitted; Phase 2+ (contact mechanics etc.) is NOT blocked. Caveats: confirm each ported file's 'or later' header; LAMMPS-proper headers are version-unspecified (murkier). NOTICE/README/lib.rs corrected in commit e08fecf.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: HTGR WATER INGRESS: this reaction/reactor port is important for HTGR water/steam-ingress accident analysis — the steam-graphite (C+H2O->CO+H2), water-gas-shift (CO+H2O->CO2+H2), and Boudouard (C+CO2->2CO) chemistry is exactly Equilibrium+Kinetic reactions driven in CSTR/PFR reactors.
